description:
## Background

After the canonical mise task graph exists, retaining `check`, `fix`, `test`, and `doctor` package scripts would preserve a second source of truth. Agent prompts and documentation also currently teach raw package-manager and tool commands. This would make the new gate easy to bypass accidentally and would leave stale instructions for future agents.

The repository has two different doctor tools: Ultracite Doctor validates Ultracite setup, while React Doctor scans React code health. They must remain separate in the documentation and task names.

E2E scripts are intentionally different: they orchestrate desktop scenarios and must remain unchanged.

## What to build

Remove obsolete gate scripts and migrate all repository-owned agent and documentation callers to the canonical mise tasks without changing e2e scenario behavior.

## Technical Approach

Remove from `package.json`:

- `check`;
- `fix`;
- `test`;
- `doctor`.

Retain `prepare`, `dev`, `build`, `preview`, `tauri`, and all `e2e:*`/`test:e2e:*` scripts.

Update:

- `AGENTS.md` with the top-level `mise run gate` rule, mise bootstrap instructions, `mise run check`, `mise run fix`, `mise run ultracite:doctor`, and `mise run doctor` guidance;
- `.pi/chains/implement-bead.chain.md` to validate with `mise run gate`;
- `.pi/prompts/implement-bead.md` to use mise tasks;
- `docs/agents/webdriver-e2e.md` to use `mise run test` and `mise run rust:test` for unit tests while retaining all e2e scenario commands;
- `.devin/config.json` to allow `Exec(mise)` while treating existing permission entries as permission data, not gate definitions.

Run a caller inventory before deletion. Use command-shaped searches and manually classify results as gate definitions, staged adapters, e2e scenarios, documentation examples, source comments, or permission allowlists. Do not use a blanket zero-match search for words such as `vitest` or `cargo test`.

## Considerations

- Do not edit `.agents/skills/**`.
- Do not change any `pnpm test:e2e:*` scenario script.
- Keep `build` as `tsc && vite build` unless the gate issue changes the explicit build decision.
- If React Doctor’s old package script is removed, the replacement command is `mise run doctor`; Ultracite setup diagnostics use `mise run ultracite:doctor`.
- The external Devin blueprint is handled by the final handoff issue, not by pretending `.devin/config.json` contains the blueprint.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `check`, `fix`, `test`, and `doctor` are removed from `package.json`.
- [ ] `prepare`, application commands, build, and all e2e scenario scripts remain unchanged in behavior.
- [ ] All four named repository documentation/agent surfaces use the correct mise tasks.
- [ ] Ultracite Doctor and React Doctor are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] `.devin/config.json` allows mise execution.
- [ ] No obsolete package-script caller remains in repository-owned executable or agent guidance surfaces.
- [ ] E2E scenario invocations remain unchanged.

## Test Plan

- Run the command-shaped caller inventory before and after edits.
- Run `mise run check`, `mise run typecheck`, `mise run test`, and `mise run gate`.
- Run the existing e2e scenario smoke command(s) to confirm scripts were not changed.
- Verify `package.json` script keys programmatically.
- Inspect all remaining raw command mentions and record why each is intentionally retained.

## Triage
